plan.notes: Source: TMCC official catalog 'Dance, Fine Arts, AA' (https://catalog.tmcc.edu/degrees-certificates/fine-art-dance-aa/), 'Recommended Course Schedule' plan-of-study grid (Dance Career Map), hand-transcribed 2026-10-02. Grid rows shown only as footnote number(s) with units do not name a specific course in the published schedule — modeled as choice slots with the catalog's footnote number(s) preserved in choice_note. The catalog defines footnote 6 on this page ('See Approved List of Foreign Language choices for AA Degree'); footnotes 4 and 5 are not defined on this page — see advisor. Per-course prerequisites are not listed in the schedule grid.
